The replacement bullet and interpretive note explicitly retain those limits. 'Reveals finer boundaries' is read as a rendering description under these qualifications, not a universal error guarantee.

Raster compositing is not a new quadrant invariant or proof; the proposed reversed-order control is explicitly unimplemented.
